equivalents.CONFIRM-SQL-ID: A valid signature digest contains the action id, so distinct valid rows cannot match this digest. The mandatory read-by-id and affected-row check remain.
equivalents.CONFIRM-SQL-STATE: The same transaction already refused non-requested state. The production statements between read and write only touch enrollment and counter rows. The CAS check retains a second fence.
equivalents.CLAIM-PRE-OWNER: The v10 CHECK makes a non-NULL owner invalid on a confirmed row. The SQL owner predicate still refuses a malformed owned row.
equivalents.CLAIM-SQL-ID: A valid signature digest uniquely identifies the signed action id. The read-by-id, digest check and affected-row fence remain.
equivalents.CLAIM-SQL-STATE: The same transaction previously read and required confirmed. No statement writes the action between read and update.
equivalents.CLAIM-SQL-GEN: The exact phase generation was read and compared in the same transaction before the update.
equivalents.CLAIM-SQL-OWNER: The same transaction required an empty owner before the update. The schema also requires NULL on confirmed rows.
equivalents.CLAIM-SQL-EXPIRY-CMP: The precheck rejects now at or after expiry with the same injected time in the same transaction. The SQL comparison stays strict.
equivalents.CLAIM-SQL-DIGEST: The same transaction already compared the exact digest. No write can change that row between its own read and update.
